title: Notification regarding single bench matter of Hon'ble the Chief Justice and Hon'ble Mr. Justice A.Guneshwar Sharma to be listed on 07-08-2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
A. Guneshwar Sharma to be listed on 07-08-2026 will be taken up on the same day before

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 6th August, 2026
+b
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ : it is informed to all learned members of the Bar
and litigants that Single Bench matters of Hon’ble the Chief Justice and Hon'ble Mr. Justice
A. Guneshwar Sharma to be listed on 07-08-2026 will be taken up on the same day before
the Single Bench of Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh for fixing dates, extension of interim
orders as well as for taking up urgent matters.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(KH. A]IT SINGH)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Endt. No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ III BC -b'i Imphal, the 6th August, 2026
Copy to:
1. The Principal Secretary to Hon’ble The Chief Justice, High Court of Manipur.
2. Tbe P.S. to Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh, Judge, High Court of Manipur.
3. We P.S to Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma, Judge, High Court of Manipur.
4. TIle Advocate General, Government of Manipur.
5. Tbe Chairman, Bar Council of Manipur.
6. The Registrar General, High Court of Manipur.
7. The Registrar (Vigilane)/(Translation Wing)/(Admn.), High Court of Manipur.

11. The President, AMBA, Manipur.

Tamenglong / Thouba I / Ukhrul.
13. All the Joint Registrars, High Court of Manipur.
14. All the Deputy Registrars, Language Officer, Court Managers Gr. II, High Court of Manipur.
15. All the Assistant Registrars, Librarian, High Court of Manipur.
16. The System Analysts, High Court of Manipur.
- He is requested to upload the same on official website.
17. All the Superintendents/Court Officers/Stamp Reporter/Protocol Officer, High Court of Manipur.
18. All the Court Masters, High Court of Manipur.
19. The Concerned/Guard File.
J&. #->1-
REGISTRAK (3UDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
